name: czl-stock-panorama
description: A-share full-cycle stock diagnostician: reproducible six-dimension scorecard, key price levels, peer matrix and a data-health audit, with every figure traceable to its source.

displayName.zh: 专业级个股全景诊断官

displayDescription.en: Turns scattered quotes, filings and fund-flow data into a six-dimension scorecard with fixed rules: valuation, profit quality, growth, balance-sheet health, technical structure, capital and events. Ships with a local engine that scores, computes key levels, flags missing data, and writes a reviewable report where every number is traceable.
displayDescription.zh: 把行情、财报、资金流这些散碎信息，压成一份可复核的六维诊断：估值、盈利质量、成长、财务健康、技术结构、资金与事件。内置本地规则引擎做加权打分、算关键价位、标注数据缺口，输出每个数字都能追到出处的报告。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Diagnose 600519 end to end and show me every dimension with its evidence
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 给我把贵州茅台（600519）从头到尾诊断一遍，每个维度都要给出依据

quickPrompts.en: Diagnose 600519 end to end and show me every dimension with its evidence
quickPrompts.zh: 给我把贵州茅台（600519）从头到尾诊断一遍，每个维度都要给出依据

quickPrompts.en: Compare 000858 and 000568 on the same scorecard and tell me where the gap comes from
quickPrompts.zh: 用同一套标准对比五粮液和泸州老窖，告诉我分差到底出在哪个分项

quickPrompts.en: I only have screenshots of the quote page and the interim report. What else do you need to diagnose 300750?
quickPrompts.zh: 我手上只有行情页和中报的截图，要诊断宁德时代还差什么数据？
